title: feat: show GitHub stars and Discord online on the homepage
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Part of landing #14472 in steps.

- Adds the GitHub star count and the number of people online in Discord to the homepage stats line.
- The visitor's browser fetches both directly from GitHub and Discord, so there is no new Worker endpoint.
- A count stays hidden while it loads or if the request fails.
- `cachePublic.ts` and `useAsync.ts` are copied unchanged from `feat/website-v2`, and so is the stars/Discord part of `community.ts`. `.gitignore` now matches v2's, so `src/data/` is tracked.
- Discord's CORS header echoes the page's origin but doesn't send `Vary: Origin`, so the widget fetch skips the browser cache. Otherwise, after visiting www.pollinations.ai, a visitor to pollinations.ai would get a cached response that fails CORS.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Stats line | 10K devs · 1.5M requests · 500+ apps | + 5.2K GitHub stars · 1.2K online in Discord |

Checked in a local build at 1280px and 390px. Each stat stays on one line, the page doesn't scroll sideways, and there are no CORS errors, including when the page is opened from a second origin.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The garden has company
gist.blurb: The homepage stats line gets two more neighbors: GitHub stars and people online in Discord. If either count is unavailable, it quietly stays out of the way.
gist.summary: The homepage adds GitHub star and Discord online counts beside its existing stats, fetching both directly in the visitor's browser without a new Worker endpoint.
gist.impact: Visitors get a quick view of community activity; counts stay hidden while loading or if a request fails, and the Discord fetch avoids a cross-origin browser-cache issue.
gist.visual_concept: Show the pollinations.ai homepage as a cozy garden noticeboard with GitHub stars and Discord online visitors represented by a star counter and a small gathering of friendly sprites. Polli tends the display; lime-green code-plants connect it to the existing stats line.
